title: IntelEngine: NPC Autonomy & Faction Politics
tagline: Give Skyrim’s NPCs agency: tasks, schedules, autonomous stories, and faction politics.
description:
**IntelEngine** gives Skyrim's NPCs the ability to act autonomously through SkyrimNet. NPCs can travel, deliver messages, fetch or escort people, schedule meetings and tasks, spread gossip, pursue personal storylines, and take part in an evolving faction-politics system.

# 🌏 **4.0, the living world.**
People you know get on with their lives while you are away, ask things of you that the journal keeps, and come back to what is still open between you. The director judges each person on their own memories and only lets someone come when they have a real reason, at a good moment: arriving in a town or an inn, coming home, leaving a dungeon, waking up. Never in a private moment.

- **Stories of the town** are written for the people actually there: mysteries with real clues, hauntings at night, hunts with a trail to follow, captives to cut loose, papers you can read. Each has its own journal quest with markers.
- **Quests decided by the world**: a stolen keepsake, a brigand to deal with, a venture with a follower you left behind. The game checks every step, so nobody can talk their way past one.
- **Followers you left behind** live lives of their own, and you may meet them again on the road, at a dungeon or wherever their life has taken them.
- **The talk of the day** spreads from inn to inn and fades.
- **Politics you take part in**: ranks, battles fought on a field you can be called to, champions, turncoats and pay. A **faction editor** on the dashboard replaces editing factions.yaml by hand (new and not yet tested in game).
- **Any language**: places, people, times and words like "home" understood in ten languages, and the on-screen text translated.
- **No stutter**: nothing IntelEngine does takes more than about half a millisecond of a frame (measured).

Six new settings under **"Living world"** decide how much of this you get.

## ⚠️ **4.0 is a major update: the mod behaves differently once you update.**
The default "Living world" level is **Lives**, for new games and for saves you update. That turns on the new director, the town stories, the new quests and lives for the followers you left behind. **For 3.8's behaviour, set "Living world" to "Classic".** Above Classic, 3.8's rescue, clear-out and find-item quests are replaced by the town stories and the new quests, and skirmishes by battles on a field.

**Back up your save first.** Install the whole package over your current version (alpha users: install over the alpha). One 3.8.3 save with a task under way loaded and played on a small test setup, but that is not a real playthrough, so keep a copy or start a new game. A save that got stuck at start-up on 3.8.2 may not recover: start a new game. Saves older than 3.6 still need the separate converter before loading.

**What was tested.** Played on **Skyrim SE 1.5.97** (a small test setup and a full Nolvus load order). The 1.6.640, 1.6.1170 and **1.7.104** builds were started, saved and loaded on a bare setup, with no story played there. **VR 1.4.15** loads saves; a battle has not been seen on VR. Not run: 1.6.353 and older, GOG. Use the matching versions of **SKSE and Address Library**.

## 🐛 **Have issues?** Report them on the IntelEngine-GamePlugin GitHub issues page, with `IntelEngine.log` and `SkyrimNet.log`.

**Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27 or newer.** Travel to Named Places needs SkyrimNet v1.0.0-rc1 or newer. Optional: Magelight UI 1.7.1+ for the dashboard and popups; SeverActions, SkyrimNet Relationships, Kinship and Fertility Mode are read when present.

Created by **Galanx**, who designed and wrote 4.0. With **PhospheneOverdrive** (3.8.3, VR and Skyrim 1.7 fixes, eight pull requests), **Nikolay Polukhin** (escort fix) and **Lanosity** (natural-language time parser).

changelog:
**4.0.0: the living world.** A major update.

**When you update**
- "Living world" defaults to **Lives**, on updated saves too. Set it to **Classic** for 3.8's behaviour.
- Above Classic, 3.8's rescue, clear-out and find-item quests give way to town stories and new quests, and skirmishes to battles on a field.
- Skipped time no longer counts toward the pace (there is a switch for it).

**New**
- The director sends only people with a real reason, at a good moment, never a private one.
- Unfinished business: requests are kept in the journal with a marker and a fixed reward.
- Quests: a stolen keepsake, a brigand, a venture with a former follower.
- Stories of the town: hauntings, hunts, captives, thieves, murders and courtships, with branching endings.
- Followers you left behind live their own lives; meet them on the road, at a dungeon or wherever their life takes them.
- The talk of the day spreads between holds and fades.
- Battles on open ground: pick a side, earn ranks and pay.
- A faction editor on the dashboard replaces editing factions.yaml by hand. Not yet tested in game: keep a copy of your file.
- Ten languages understood, on-screen text translated.
- No stutter: at most about half a millisecond of a frame.
- Travel with companions, to Named Places, "in two hours".
- A new World page on the dashboard.

**Fixed**
- Carriage drivers and ferrymen are never sent; Remove works for fetch/escort; a failure is no longer repeated over and over; other mods' packages are left alone; names in non-UTF-8 plugins no longer crash.
- A load could leave the whole mod asleep; a new game no longer hangs at start-up; Sparks bolts are visible again.

Install the whole package over 3.8.x or the alphas, and back up your save first. Requires SkyrimNet Beta 27+.

Thanks to everyone who tested the alphas!
